propositions: rebar-brainstorm/SKILL.md currently instructs running plan-review on each ticket immediately after creation before dependency links exist, contradicting the gate behavior that fast-fails with exit 2 on blocked tickets
plan-review must run only on unblocked tickets in dependency order after the child dependency graph is established via blocks/depends_on links
rebar ready command identifies the unblocked set of tickets eligible for plan-review
empty rebar ready result indicates a cycle or authoring error in the dependency graph requiring inspection and resolution
rebar-implement/SKILL.md already correctly treats the dependency graph as a precondition and claims/reviews only unblocked tickets via rebar ready/next-batch, requiring no changes
